Recorded claim:
Remove the production mousedown listener/branch; `synthesizeRadioCardClick()` wraps only the four synthetic radio-card mouse clicks in `AccessibilityUtils.suppressClickHandling(true/false)`, retaining selection, change-event, keyboard, and tabindex assertions. The applied two-file update passed the focused enabled-a11y Mochitest (228 passed/0 failed/1 TODO), ESLint (0 problems), Node syntax checks, and `git diff --check`. [Task 2]
